scope: Current premium frontend, foreground homepage steady-state observation; not affected-device acceptance or a GPU benchmark
method: requestAnimationFrame intervals, every 30th interval retained; PerformanceObserver longtask installed at sample start. Scene canvases confirmed is-live and visually rendered. No navigation or theme/viewport change during the window.
limitations: Frame callback intervals are not GPU presentation times, device responsiveness, or end-to-end input latency.
Only every 30th interval is stored; maximum is sampled maximum, not maximum of every frame.
Long-task observation starts after initial navigation and cannot characterize shader startup blocking.
The original affected device was unavailable; its five-minute lag has not been independently reproduced or cleared.
No same-device pre-upgrade baseline was measured in this round; this does not prove a relative speedup.
Quality API remains high. Actual algorithm and field buffers are 1440x900; API pixelRatio must not be presented as the measured canvas ratio.
